items.item: Runs sf code-analyzer run (with --target force-app or the changed files) and reads the results

items.evidence: Critical (1) and High (2) violations always block.

items.item: Also checks CRUD/FLS, sharing, loops, hard-coded Ids, automation overlap, test asserts and the rollback plan
items.evidence: Checklist rows: CRUD/FLS, Sharing keyword, SOQL or DML inside a loop, Hard-coded Ids, Automation overlap, Tests that assert behaviour, Rollback plan written down
